# sauth_organization (Resource)

The organization records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) name

### Optional

- `description` (String) description
- `external_id` (String) external id
- `kind` (String) free text kind of the organization, such as group
- `owner_id` (String) owning organization id; without it the organization is a new customer root
